review_candidates.title: Senior Director, Technology Operations
review_candidates.description: About Us The Community Preservation Corporation (CPC) believes stable and sustainable affordable housing is the foundation of strong communities and we strive to contribute to comprehensive neighborhood revitalization through our lending and partnerships. A nationally recognized leader in affordable housing finance, CPC has provided a consistent source of capital to underserved housing markets throughout New York State since our inception in 1974. Today, CPC stands as the largest CDFI solely committed to investing in multifamily housing, having invested more than $15 billion to finance the creation and preservation of more than 230,000 units of quality housing in neighborhoods across New York State and beyond. CPC has a robust construction lending platform, a mortgage bank, and equity and impact investment platforms that focus on our three goals: Expanding Affordable Housing, Closing the Racial Wealth Gap and Investing in the Green Economy. As a member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects that make a real difference in people's lives. We're looking for talented individuals who are passionate about our mission and share our values of commitment, respect, excellence, accountability, and collaboration. Role Summary The Senior Director, Technology Operations is a key member of the Information Technology leadership team responsible for leading CPC's enterprise technology operations and ensuring the delivery of secure, reliable, and high-performing technology services that enable the organization's mission and business objectives. Reporting directly to the CIO, this role provides strategic and operational leadership across IT Service Management (ITSM), End User Services, Infrastructure, Networks, Cloud Operations, Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity Operations, Technology Engineering, and Vendor Management. The Senior Director is responsible for establishing operational excellence through modern service management practices, process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement while delivering exceptional employee technology experience. The ideal candidate is an experienced, customer-focused technology leader with a passion for building high-performing teams, developing operational capabilities, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and service excellence. This individual will partner closely with business leaders and strategic technology partners to modernize CPC's technology operations, strengthen cybersecurity, improve operational resilience, and support the organization's continued growth and digital transformation. What You’ll Do Leadership & Organizational Excellence Build, lead, and continuously evolve a world-class Technology Operations organization that delivers exceptional customer experience, operational excellence, and business value. Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of IT professionals through coaching, performance management, training, succession planning, and career development. Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centric service delivery. Develop organizational capabilities, operating procedures, and service standards that enable scalable growth and operational maturity. Technology Operations Strategy & Governance Develop and execute CPC's Technology Operations strategy and roadmap in alignment with the overall IT strategy and business objectives. Establish and mature IT Service Management (ITSM) capabilities based on ITIL best practices, including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Configuration, Knowledge, Request, and Service Level Management. Define operational KPIs, SLAs, dashboards, and executive reporting to measure service performance, operational effectiveness, and customer satisfaction. Drive continuous service improvement initiatives through automation, process optimization, standardization, and operational governance. Enterprise Technology Operations Provide strategic leadership for enterprise technology operations supporting CPC headquarters and regional offices, ensuring highly available, secure, resilient, and reliable technology services. Oversee End User Computing, Service Desk, Infrastructure, Networks, Cloud Services, Endpoint Management, Identity & Access Management, Operational Cybersecurity, and enterprise technology support. Ensure operational readiness, business continuity, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and technology lifecycle management across the enterprise. Lead operational planning to support future business growth, modernization initiatives, and evolving technology requirements. Technology Service Delivery Ensure the delivery of reliable, secure, and customer-focused technology services that consistently meet or exceed established service levels. Continuously improve the IT service portfolio, end-user experience, and operational efficiency through service optimization and automation. Partner with business leaders to understand operational needs and translate them into scalable technology solutions. Establish a service-oriented culture focused on responsiveness, transparency, communication, and measurable business outcomes. Program & Project Delivery Provide executive oversight for Technology Operations projects, ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations. Prioritize operational initiatives and technology investments that improve reliability, security, scalability, and user experience. Collaborate with the PMO and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise technology initiatives that support CPC's strategic objectives. Sponsor and champion continuous improvement initiatives that increase operational maturity and reduce technology risk. Vendor & Strategic Partner Management Develop and manage strategic relationships with Managed Service Providers (MSPs), technology vendors, cloud providers, and external partners. Establish vendor governance processes, performance metrics, service reviews, and contractual accountability to ensure delivery of high-quality services. Lead vendor selection activities, including RFI, RFP, RFQ, contract negotiations, and ongoing performance management. Optimize vendor relationships to maximize value, control costs, reduce operational risk, and support CPC's long-term technology strategy. Cybersecurity & Risk Management Partner with vendor’s leadership to ensure operational security controls, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and infrastructure security are effectively implemented. Support enterprise cybersecurity, compliance, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives through operational excellence and technology governance. Promote a security-first culture across technology operations while ensuring reliable and resilient service delivery. Skills And Experience 15+ years of progressive experience in Information Technology, including leadership of enterprise IT Operations, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Engineering, and Service Delivery. Proven experience building, leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing IT teams with a strong customer service focus. Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences while driving operational excellence and continuous process improvement. Strong technical expertise in enterprise networking, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies, cloud platforms, endpoint management, identity & access management, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery, and cybersecurity operations. Demonstrated experience supporting and maintaining enterprise firewalls, switches, wireless networks, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure, VPN, endpoint protection, and enterprise collaboration platforms. Experience implementing and managing IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Knowledge, and Service Level Management. Strong understanding of cybersecurity best practices, vulnerability management, endpoint security, disaster recovery, business continuity, and technology risk management. Process-oriented leader with the ability to standardize operations, improve service delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and leverage technology to increase efficiency. Proven experience managing Managed Service Providers (MSPs), technology vendors, strategic outsourcing relationships, and enterprise technology contracts. Demonstrated success leading infrastructure upgrades, technology modernization initiatives, enterprise projects, and organizational change. Strong financial and business acumen, including budgeting, vendor management, procurement, asset lifecycle management, and resource planning. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills. Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent professional experience, demonstrated leadership, and relevant industry certifications will be considered. Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft, Cisco, VMware, CompTIA, Azure, AWS, or cybersecurity certifications are preferred. KPIs (success criteria) Service Excellence Achieve and maintain 90%+ End User Satisfaction while continuously improving the overall employee technology experience. Meet or exceed established IT Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident response, request fulfillment, and service delivery. IT Service Management (ITSM) Maturity Successfully develop and execute the IT Service Improvement Plan (SIP), including: Implementation of ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and Knowledge Management processes. Launch of an enterprise IT Service Portal and Service Catalog. Implementation of standardized IT communications and customer engagement strategy. Modernization of the IT Service Desk experience. Enhancement of the new employee onboarding technology experience. Operational Excellence Improve service efficiency by reducing recurring incidents, increasing first-contact resolution, and optimizing service delivery through automation and process improvement. Maintain high availability, reliability, and operational performance across CPC's enterprise technology environment. Cybersecurity & Risk Improve CPC's cybersecurity maturity by successfully executing the Cybersecurity Improvement Roadmap and achieving targeted SecurityStudio S2 assessment scores. Ensure operational compliance with established cybersecurity policies, disaster recovery, business continuity, and technology governance standards. Leadership & Continuous Improvement Build and develop a high-performing Technology Operations organization while maintaining strong employee engagement, talent development, and succession planning. Establish executive dashboards and operational KPIs that provide visibility into service performance, customer satisfaction, operational health, and continuous improvement initiatives. review_candidates.description: Position Specific Description Recruitment Number 26-176TO , Information Technology Specialist V (Server Management), $6,221 to $6,998 per month (SR-24, Step D to G), Honolulu, Oahu. Summary Of Duties This position works specifically in the Server Management Branch and works with information technology (IT) such as web services, database connectivily, email systems, storage systems and backup/restore functions; helps to setup and maintain servers, storage systems, backup systems, and provide support for email systems; provides technical guidance to staff on Windows Servers with Active Directory and will need to address issues among the circuits statewide. The work includes analysis, specification, design, build, implementation, and support of IT. The work has statewide impact and requires working with general Judiciary staff, Judiciary ITSD staff, Circuit IT staff, Executive Branch IT staff, vendors, and Judiciary clients. The position spends a greater portion of their time working on the addition, upgrade, troubleshooting and support of IT. The IT typically includes servers (both virtual and stand-alone), centralized storage systems, centralized and distributed backup systems, peripherals, associated software and system administrator accounts for host systems. The work involves analysis, design, planning, documentation, implementation and other support duties, but may also be expected to assist in other areas as part of a project, as needed. To be acceptable, the experience must have been of such scope, level, and quality as to assure the possession of comparable knowledge, skills and abilities. The education or experience background must also demonstrate the ability to write clear and comprehensive reports and other documents; read and interpret complex written material; and solve complex problems logically and systematically. The work must have demonstrated knowledge and understanding of information technology principles, methods, techniques and practices; computer hardware, software and peripheral equipment; and personal computer, server, mini and/or mainframe operating systems. Desired Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Experience with enterprise hardware systems (e.g. IBM Power Systems, Lenovo Systems and Cisco Systems) and the associated operating systems such as AIX, Linux, WIndows Server Experience with virtualization software like VMware or Hyper-V. Ability to keep abreast and up-to-date with new IT trends, processes and systems. Knowledge and experience with backup/restore systems. Knowldge of email systems. Knowledge and experience with Microsoft's M365 Suite (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Sharepoint). People/person skills such as conflict resolution and interpersonal relationship building capabilities. Supervisory Aptitude : At the V level, supervisory aptitude rather than actual supervisory experience may be accepted. Supervisory aptitude is the demonstration of aptitude or potential for the performance of supervisory duties through successful completion of regular or special assignments which involve some supervisory responsibilities or aspects; by serving as a group or team leader, or in similar work in which opportunities for demonstrating supervisory capabilities exist; by completion of training courses in supervision accompanied by application of supervisory skills in work assignments; or by favorable appraisals by a supervisor indicating the possession of supervisory potential. Substitutions Allowed : Possession of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in computer science or in another major which included completion of course work comparable to a major in computer science may be substituted for six (6) months of the required Specialized Experience. Partial completion of a master’s degree program in computer science from an accredited college or university may be substituted on a month-for-month basis up to a maximum of one (1) year for the required Specialized Experience. Possession of a master’s degree in computer science from an accredited college or university may be substituted for one and one-half (1-1/2) years of the required Specialized Experience. Possession of a Ph.D. in computer science from an accredited college or university may be substituted for two and one-half (2-1/2) years of the required Specialized Experience. Supplemental Information Any additional information may be attached to your online application, submitted by email to Recruitment@courts.hawaii.gov, or mailed to the following address: Hawaii State Judiciary, Human Resources Department, 426 Queen Street, First Floor, Honolulu, Hawaii 96813. Education: If you are using education as a substitute for experience, you must submit a copy of your official transcripts or diploma at the time of application. review_candidates.description: Your Moneris Career – The Opportunity Join the Platform Services and Systems Administration team as a hands-on Systems Engineer focused on defining, modernizing, and automating operating environment standards across Moneris' hybrid enterprise infrastructure. Your first major initiative will include updating operating system build standards aligned to NIST, CIS Benchmark Level 2, and PCI DSS hardening requirements, then creating Windows Server 2025 and Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 images for repeatable deployment across the estate. Build pipeline-based deployment patterns for repeatable image delivery across Nutanix, VMware, and Azure environments. Hands-on experience with Windows Server and Red Hat Enterprise Linux administration, standards, hardening, patching, and lifecycle management. Strong automation and Infrastructure as Code experience using Ansible, Red Hat Satellite, Terraform, Bash, PowerShell, and source control practices. Broad infrastructure experience across VMware vSphere, Nutanix AHV, enterprise storage (SAN/NAS/HCI), backup, recovery, disaster recovery, Active Directory, Entra ID, and monitoring. review_candidates.description: RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes CLEARANCE TYPE: Top Secret TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time Description At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. Northrop Grumman Space Systems—Missile Defense Integration offers an excellent opportunity for a Principal Engineer Network III (26-391) to join our team of skilled and diverse professionals. Based in Colorado Springs, CO, this role is essential to supporting the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at the strategic, regional, and operational levels. This position does not provide relocation assistance and requires on-site work with no remote options. Position Overview The Command and Control, Battle Management, and Communications (C2BMC) program is a key component of the Missile Defense System. It is a vital operational system that enables the U.S. president, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at strategic, regional, and operational levels to plan ballistic missile defense operations systematically, collectively monitor the battle, and dynamically control networked sensors and weapon systems to achieve global and regional mission goals. C2BMC supports layered missile defense capabilities that enable an optimized response to threats across all ranges and flight phases. It serves as a force multiplier by networking, integrating, and synchronizing autonomous sensor and weapon systems and operations, both globally and regionally, to improve performance. C2BMC is essential for all ground and flight tests that verify and demonstrate the current and future capabilities of missile defense systems. In this role, the candidate will serve as a Network Development Engineer, supporting build-out and deployments to the operational environment as needed.
